thumbnail_prompt:
ARM A - EVOLVED LOOK (final prompt, 2026-11-28):
16:9 YouTube thumbnail in traditional Indian miniature painting style (Kangra / Pahari school): flat perspective with no realistic 3D lighting, fine ink outlines, matte gouache colour, delicate patterned textiles, a stylised face in three-quarter profile. NO ornate border and NO parchment panel: the painting fills the frame edge to edge. Deep indigo night palette with one warm lantern glow. A single figure at rest: a woman lying back on a bed against patterned pillows, one arm behind her head, eyes closed, face relaxed, under a dark blue floral quilt. Her face, arms and blouse are painted in light warm tones so she stands out clearly; pale cream blouse. A closed laptop on the floor beside the bed, a small lit lantern and two books on a low side table, a plain window with a crescent moon and a few small distant lights, a flowering branch in the top right corner, no palace or domes. Simple clothing, no heavy jewellery. A surbahar (a large, long-necked bass sitar) in shadow in the left corner, not played. Text: "WORK IS DONE" in a BOLD warm cream classical serif typeface with strong thick-and-thin strokes (the same heavy weight as a bold Roman book title), large, upper left, about two-thirds of the frame width, not covering the figure.

ARM B - CURRENT LOOK (control): the usual Raga Focus Pichwai-Kangra miniature - ornate floral border, cream parchment text panel (right ~40%), dark indigo serif. Same scene as Arm A. Text in the panel: "WORK IS DONE".
